hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/machicomoco ('13 with electric and water hookups', 'Outlets at electric/water sites accept 20, 30 and 50-amp current'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 27 campsites: 13 electric/water sites for tents, pop-ups and RVs up to 60 ft, and 14 walk-in tent-only sites. Two camping units per site, only one axled; site rental includes parking for two vehicles. Gravel/pebble pads. No river views.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/machicomoco ('The campground has a total of 27 campsites; 13 with electric and water hookups for various equipment – tents, popups and RVs up to 60 feet long; 14 walk-in tent-only sites. The campground offers no river views.', 'Sites are limited to two camping units, only one of which may be axled'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Campground bathhouse with restrooms and hot showers. No laundry in the park (nearest laundromat nine minutes south on Route 17). Gift shop at the main entrance building.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/machicomoco ('The campground has a bathhouse with restrooms with hot showers', 'LAUNDRY None currently at this site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All sites are available through site-specific reservations.' Check-in 4 p.m. (a site is not guaranteed before then), check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/machicomoco ('All sites are available for site-specific reservations', check-in/out), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the season (first Friday in March to first Monday in December, already manual), the RV base at the $37 electric/water sites (the $27 sites are walk-in tent-only), reservable by site; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12. Added 50-amp electric with water, 27 sites (13 for RVs to 60 ft), bathhouse showers, no laundry. Not stated: sewer, dump station, pull-throughs, booking window/cutoff for this park (left inherited), fcfs.
